title: Avoid repeating full checkpoint-ledger compaction work for each session in a removal cascade
outcome: A session/delegation/project removal cascade compacts eligible checkpoint history in bounded shared-owner work while preserving every unresolved, unlatched, linked, active and quarantined operation.
acceptance: Use an existing removal or compaction owner to avoid repeated full-ledger clone/scan work proportional to both cascade length and retained history.
Show unchanged retention of unresolved, unlatched, linked, active-flight/receipt and quarantined persisted operations, plus continued cleanup of eligible deleted-session history.
Validate with representative cascade and no-op cases and obtain the required independent source reviews.
